_comment: Shrink-only. Files that mention an ARM helper yet legitimately keep a raw fetch. Each value is the WHY (>= 20 chars). A stale entry fails scripts/ci/check-arm-counted-fetch.mjs.

allow.apps/fiab-console/lib/admin/health-probe: armHost() is used only to compare a hostname against the configured endpoint (line ~440). Its three raw fetch() calls probe Key Vault / app-endpoint / dependency URLs, none of them ARM management reads.
allow.apps/fiab-console/lib/util/arm-counted-r: This IS the counted path for bare fetch: it pins the URL to the armBase() origin (SSRF-safe by construction, tested) and books the read via counted(). Its raw fetch() is the one that gets counted.
allow.apps/fiab-console/lib/clients/azure-conn: The remaining raw fetch is the Log Analytics query data plane (getLogAnalyticsHost()), not ARM; armCountedRawFetch refuses non-ARM origins by design, so it must stay a plain fetch.
allow.apps/fiab-console/lib/clients/jupyter-se: jupyterFetch targets the compute instance's own https://<hostName>/jupyter data plane, a non-ARM host; armCountedRawFetch refuses non-ARM origins by design. Its ARM call (listNotebookAccessToken) is counted.
allow.apps/fiab-console/app/api/admin/azure-re: Baselined route-toolkit route: touching it requires the toolkit migration. Left unchanged, ARM fetch uncounted until the follow-up, issue #5079.
